candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old. The child has cough or difficult breathing for 3 days. The breaths were counted for one minute while the child was calm and the respiratory rate is 42 breaths per minute. There is no chest indrawing, no stridor when calm, and no wheezing. There is no recurrent wheeze. There is no fever present every day, but fever has been present for 2 days and the temperature is 38.0°C. Malaria risk in this area is high. Malaria test was available and the result is positive. There is no identified bacterial cause of fever in this assessment and there is no obvious cause of fever. The child has generalized rash and cough seen with measles, but there is no history of measles within the last 3 months. There is no clouding of the cornea, no mouth ulcers, no pus draining from the eye, no red eyes, no runny nose, and no stiff neck. The child has diarrhoea for 3 days. There is blood in the stool. The child drinks normally. The skin pinch is normal, the eyes are not sunken, and the child is not restless or irritable. There is no history of convulsions and the child is not convulsing now. The child is not lethargic or unconscious and is able to drink or breastfeed. The child does not vomit everything. The child has ear pain, but the caregiver reports no current or previous ear discharge. There is no pus draining from the ear and no tender swelling behind the ear. Pulse oximeter is not available.
